title: Nasruddin and the Ladder
summary: Nasruddin carried a long wooden ladder into a neighbor's walled peach orchard and set it against the fruit-laden tree....
full_text:
Nasruddin carried a long wooden ladder into a neighbor's walled peach orchard and set it against the fruit-laden tree.

The owner rushed out shouting: "What are you doing with a ladder in my peach tree?"

"I am selling ladders!" replied Nasruddin calmly.

"Selling ladders in my private orchard?" cried the owner.

"My good sir," smiled Nasruddin, "a ladder is a useful piece of merchandise that can be sold anywhere in the world!"
moral: When caught in an awkward position, inventive audacity provides an exit.

quiz.question: What memorable conclusion does this story teach young readers?
